recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下成片的漿細胞樣細胞：核偏心、染色質呈車輪狀（clock-face chromatin）、細胞質呈雙染性（amphophilic）；其中混有核較大、染色質較開、帶核仁的非典型細胞，形態較單一，提示 PTLD 中的非典型漿細胞增生。
features: Sheet of plasmacytoid cells with moderate amphophilic cytoplasm
Eccentric round to oval nuclei with coarse clock-face chromatin
Admixed larger atypical cells with vesicular chromatin and visible nucleoli
Mild nuclear pleomorphism and occasional binucleate-appearing cells
Scattered small dark pyknotic/apoptotic nuclei in the background
Relatively monotonous population with few small lymphocytes
describe_en: High-power H&E section shows a sheet of plasmacytoid cells with moderate amphophilic cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin. Admixed are larger atypical cells with vesicular chromatin and visible nucleoli, and there is mild nuclear pleomorphism. Scattered apoptotic nuclei are present, while small lymphocytes are relatively few. Findings are consistent with a monotonous population of atypical plasma cells in the setting of post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder; light chain and EBV studies are needed for classification.

ddx.vs: Plasmacytic hyperplasia preserves architecture with bland polyclonal plasma cells, whereas this image shows sheets of atypical cells with nucleoli.
Plasmablastic lymphoma consists of larger immunoblast-like cells with prominent central nucleoli and very high Ki-67, rather than predominantly mature-appearing plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytoid differentiation
ddx.vs: DLBCL is predominantly large centroblasts/immunoblasts expressing CD20, whereas plasma cell lesions are CD20 negative, CD138 positive.
